cohort: 400 women in Zahedan city, Iran with childbirth experience over the past few months.
finding: Prevalence of PTSD was not significantly associated with parity, pain duration, education level or employment status, but was associated with mode of delivery, curettage, length of hospitalization, and type of pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women with PTSD were more likely to have had a mode of delivery other than normal vaginal delivery.
